title: ketcher-core 3.18.0 (EPAM's Ketcher): licence, NOTICE and copyright from Ketcher's v3.18.0 tag

components.name: ketcher-core
components.evidence: Copyright line: the banner ' * Copyright 2021 EPAM Systems' heads ketcher-core's *.modern.js files (all 476 under node_modules/ketcher-core/dist outside its vendored node_modules/, incl. index.modern.js, carry it). No LICENSE or NOTICE in the npm package (its folder holds only dist/, package.json, README.md, and for ketcher-core/-react a node_modules/). The npm registry's gitHead for 3.18.0 is f4f013e1855b71b0cbd37fc79d55b0cbe51c2371, which is what tag v3.18.0 points to (api.github.com: ref tags/v3.18.0 -> tag object 5f0a0cdd3a1564f3a43f387d3a76e571ae7d05f1 -> commit f4f013e1855b71b0cbd37fc79d55b0cbe51c2371); LICENSE, NOTICE and LICENSE-history fetched at that commit and at the tag are byte-identical. web/package-lock.json's integrity for the package equals the registry's dist.integrity. The repo LICENSE is Apache-2.0 whose appendix is filled in as 'Copyright 2021 EPAM Systems' (inside the licence body, so not a copyright line by subtraction); the copyright line is the banner at the top of every shipped dist file. LICENSE-history says Ketcher version 1 was AGPL-3.0 and version 2 was re-licensed under Apache-2.0 by EPAM; 3.18.0 is Apache-2.0 (package.json "license": "Apache-2.0"). NOTICE lists licence families of Ketcher's dependencies (incl. LGPL-2.1 and MPL-1.0) without naming files; it is reproduced whole, as Apache-2.0 §4(d) asks. Not covered here: ketcher-core also vendors dist/node_modules/subscription/index.modern.js (MIT, Marijn Haverbeke; its map's source is ../../../../../node_modules/subscription/index.js, Ketcher's lockfile says 3.0.0); EPAM's Apache banner sits on that file too. It belongs with the inlined copies.
